channel.title: Pier & Point · P24
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for P24 (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · P24: OCII's November 14, 2024 map shows the P23/P24 area as completed park; no completion date is given. The September 2023 presentation is a plan for the Port to manage P24. OCII's map labels Bayfront Park (P22) "open October 2024".
item.description: OCII's November 14, 2024 map shows the P23/P24 area as completed park; no completion date is given. The September 2023 presentation is a plan for the Port to manage P24. OCII's map labels Bayfront Park (P22) "open October 2024". Source: https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Transition.pdf ; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf ; https://socketsite.com/archives/2019/04/mission-bay-is-nearly-built-out-mission-rock-in-the-wings.html.

item.title: Correction · P24: SocketSite (April 2019) only reports the P23/P24 park as expected to be completed by the end of 2019, so the 'under construction' status was removed. OCII's September 2023 deck says the Port 'will manage' P24 rather than already managing it. A citation to our own mapping notes was replaced by the Dec 2019 land use map; the map shape now cites the land use map and the deck, its descriptions drawn from imagery are marked as observations, and the aerial photo caption no longer says 'from a departing flight'.
item.description: SocketSite (April 2019) only reports the P23/P24 park as expected to be completed by the end of 2019, so the 'under construction' status was removed. OCII's September 2023 deck says the Port 'will manage' P24 rather than already managing it. A citation to our own mapping notes was replaced by the Dec 2019 land use map; the map shape now cites the land use map and the deck, its descriptions drawn from imagery are marked as observations, and the aerial photo caption no longer says 'from a departing flight'. Source: SocketSite, 2019-04-22 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2019/04/mission-bay-is-nearly-built-out-mission-rock-in-the-wings.html); OCII, Mission Bay Parks Open Space (CAC Item 2), 2023-09 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Transition.pdf); OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, 2019-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf).

item.title: Complete · P24: OCII's November 14, 2024 CAC update map (slide 2, "Mission Bay Parks") points its label "P23 & P24" at a light-green area, the colour its legend gives as "COMPLETED PARK". This is the state shown as of the deck's date, read from the map; the deck gives no completion date and draws no parcel lines for P23/P24 (~2024)

item.title: Milestone · P24: OCII's Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation to the Mission Bay CAC (September 2023) lists P24 among the parcels the Port "will manage", with the open space to transfer "by the end of December 2023" (an expected date), and not among those listed as 'when built'. This is a plan; it does not say the lawn was complete or when it was built (~2023)
